claim: 机器生成文本检测的文献可归为五类方法：经典机器学习、深度学习、Transformer 架构、商用检测器、统计工具；Transformer 类在基准上接近 100% 准确率，而人类评测者的上限约 77%。
source_title: Human or Machine? A Survey on Machine-Generated Text Detection (IEEE Access)
quote: Detection approaches are grouped into five broad classes: classical machine learning, deep learning, transformer-based architectures, commercial AI detectors, and statistical tools. Transformer models achieve near-perfect accuracy (≈100%), while human evaluators peak at ≈77% accuracy.

claim: Binoculars 用两个相近语言模型对同一文本的困惑度比值作为零样本检测分数，在 0.01% 误报率下能检出 90% 以上的 ChatGPT 生成文本，且未用 ChatGPT 数据训练。
source_title: Spotting LLMs With Binoculars: Zero-Shot Detection of Machine-Generated Text (arXiv 2401.12070)
quote: Binoculars detects over 90% of generated samples from ChatGPT (and other LLMs) at a false positive rate of 0.01%, despite not being trained on any ChatGPT data.

claim: 检测器按原理可分为指标型（GLTR/DetectGPT/Fast-DetectGPT/Binoculars/LLMDet）、训练型分类器（RoBERTa）与商业黑盒三类，它们的阈值必须按目标误报率重新标定。
source_title: RAID: A Shared Benchmark for Robust Evaluation of Machine-Generated Text Detectors (ACL 2024)
quote: We benchmark 12 detectors (8 open- and 4 closed-source) ... threshold for each model such that the resulting false positive rate of the detector is 5%.

claim: SynthID-Text 只改采样过程嵌入水印，不改模型训练、不增加可见字符；用 Gemini 生产环境约 2000 万条带/不带水印响应的对照实验确认文本质量未变（论文另报 30 层 tournament sampling 只增加 0.57% 延迟）。
source_title: Scalable watermarking for identifying large language model outputs (Nature 634)
quote: a live experiment that assessed feedback from nearly 20 million Gemini6 responses, again confirming the preservation of text quality
note: 延迟 0.57% 与点赞/点踩差异出自同文结果章节，抓取只覆盖到摘要级文本，故按未逐字复核处理。

claim: 2026 年 RAID 榜首是稀疏自编码器方案 BASE-SAE，说明「可审计的检测方向」成为一条新路线，而非只是分类器打分。
source_title: RAID leaderboard
quote: 1 | BASE-SAE | 86.4 | Building Auditable AI Text Detectors with Sparse Autoencoders | 2026-10-21

claim: 在 RAID 固定 5% 误报率的协议下，最强检测器约 86.4%，Originality.ai 85.0、Binoculars 79.6、Fast-DetectGPT 73.6、Winston 71.0、GPTZero 66.5、GLTR 62.6——即所谓 99% 是不同阈值下的数字。
source_title: RAID leaderboard
quote: 3 | Originality.ai | 85.0 ... 4 | Binoculars | 79.6 ... 8 | GPTZero | 66.5 ... 9 | GLTR | 62.6

claim: 用「看起来合理」的默认阈值（如 0.5）时，开源指标型检测器误报率可高达 100%（GLTR），商用检测器则基本都低于 1.7%。
source_title: RAID (ACL 2024) Table 4
quote: On the contrary, closed-source detectors seem to be calibrated fairly well, with none having an FPR above 1.7%.

claim: 芝加哥大学 BFI 的对照实验：Pangram 在中长文本上误报与漏报都接近 0，GPTZero 约 0.7% 误报、0.06 漏报率，开源 RoBERTa 误报率 30–78%；且 GPTZero 面对 StealthGPT 类「人性化」工具时漏报率升到 50% 以上。
source_title: Artificial Writing and Automated Detection (Becker Friedman Institute)
quote: In contrast, the open-source RoBERTa base is deemed unsuitable for high-stakes applications, misclassifying most human text with false positive rates of approximately 30-78% ... GPTZero largely losing its capacity to detect AI-generated text, showing false negative rate scores around 50% and above

claim: Epoch AI 2026 年 7 月独立测试：人类文本 495 段中 Pangram 与 GPTZero 均 0 误报、Originality.ai 误报 19 段（3.8%）；直白提示生成的 AI 文本漏报 ≤0.7%；但让模型模仿某位作者风格后，漏报升到 10.1%/10.8%/17.8%，模仿科学写作时 24–29% 漏报。
source_title: AI detectors rarely flag human writing, but sometimes miss AI text imitating real authors (Epoch AI)
quote: Pangram 0 495 0.00 ... Originality.ai 19 495 3.84 ... AI, imitating a human author, False negative, Pangram 30 297 10.10

claim: VUB 2026 年同行评议研究（160 篇 4000+ 词论文）中，纯 AI 论文仅 Pangram 检出 97.5%，Turnitin、Copyleaks、GPTZero 均为 0%；经「人性化」处理后 Pangram 仍 95%，Turnitin 52.5%，Copyleaks 25%。
source_title: Third-Party Pangram Evaluations (Pangram 转述 VUB/IJEI 论文)
quote: Pangram was the only tool to reliably detect AI content ... On the fully AI-generated set the other three caught essentially none, all scoring 0%.
note: 厂商转述他刊论文，原始论文未直接读取；数字与 AI Checker Plus 汇总一致。

claim: Graphite 用三个检测器（Pangram/GPTZero/Copyleaks）测 15.7k 篇 2020–2022 年的真人文章，误报率 1.36%–1.84%；对 GPT-5/Gemini 3.1/Claude Opus 4.6 生成的文章漏报平均 0.07%–1.97%。
source_title: AI Now Writes as Many Online Articles as Humans (Graphite)
quote: Pangram 1.844% / Copyleaks 1.836% / GPTZero 1.355% ... Pangram 0.35% 3.50% 0.35% 1.40%
note: 逐字复核：误报表 1.844/1.836/1.355 与漏报表 0.35/3.50/0.35/1.40 均在页面表格中；表格单元格被自动比对拆散。

claim: 厂商自测与独立评测结论冲突：GPTZero 官方博客称在 Chicago Booth 队列上召回 99.3%、Pangram 98.9%，而独立复现中 GPTZero 在同一类任务上远逊于 Pangram。
source_title: GPTZero Tops Accuracy on Chicago Booth Benchmark in 2026 (vendor)
quote: GPTZero | 0.05% (1 error) | 99.3% (52 errors) | 99.5% ... Pangram | 0.05% (1 error) | 98.9% (85 errors) | 99.1%
note: 厂商自评，与 Epoch/VUB 的排序相反，作为「不能只看厂商数字」的证据。

claim: OpenAI 2023 年自建的分类器只能识别 26% 的 AI 文本、同时误判 9% 的人类文本，因准确率过低于 2023 年 7 月 20 日下线。
source_title: How Accurate Are AI Detectors? What Independent Studies Found (2026)
quote: OpenAI's own classifier (2023) ... Caught 26% of AI text and wrongly flagged 9% of human text. Withdrawn on July 20, 2023 "due to its low rate of accuracy."
note: OpenAI 原博客 403 无法直接取证，用二手汇总。

claim: Liang 等（Patterns 2023）用 7 个流行检测器测 91 篇中国学生 TOEFL 作文：平均误报率 61.22%，97.8% 的作文至少被一个检测器判为 AI；同一批检测器对美国八年级母语作文近乎全对。
source_title: GPT detectors are biased against non-native English writers (Patterns, 2023)
quote: they misclassified over half of the TOEFL essays as "AI-generated" (average false positive rate: 61.22%) ... 89 of the 91 TOEFL essays (97.80%) are flagged as AI-generated by at least one detector

claim: 偏差的机制是困惑度：词汇越「可预测」越被判 AI。用 ChatGPT 给 TOEFL 作文「提升用词」后误报率从 61.22% 降到 11.77%；反过来把母语作文「简化用词」后误报率从 5.19% 升到 56.65%。
source_title: GPT detectors are biased against non-native English writers (Patterns, 2023)
quote: this intervention led to a substantial reduction in misclassification, with the average false positive rate decreasing by 49.45% (from 61.22% to 11.77%) ... from an average of 5.19% across detectors to 56.65%

claim: Sadasivan 等给出「不可靠」的经验与理论论证：改写攻击把零样本检测器 AUROC 从 96.5% 打到 25.2%；5 轮递归改写把水印在 1% 误报率下的 TPR 从 99% 打到 15%；并证明当模型足够像人时，最优检测器也只能略优于随机。
source_title: Can AI-Generated Text be Reliably Detected? (arXiv 2303.11156)
quote: The AUROC of the detector drops from 99.8% to 67.9% ... true positive rate of the watermarking model at a 1% false positive rate degrades from 99% (no attack) to 15% (pp5)
note: 逐字复核：页面文本含 96.5%→25.2%、99%→15%(pp5)；MathJax 会把同一数字打印两遍，自动 n-gram 比对判为 partial。

claim: DIPPER（11B 段落级改写器）把 DetectGPT 在 1% 误报率下的检出率从 70.3% 降到 4.6%，语义几乎不变；作者提出「检索库比对」作为防御，可检出 80–97% 被改写的生成文本，但这要求模型提供方保存全部输出。
source_title: Paraphrasing evades detectors of AI-generated text, but retrieval is an effective defense (NeurIPS 2023)
quote: DIPPER drops detection accuracy of DetectGPT from 70.3% to 4.6% (at a constant false positive rate of 1%) ... it can detect 80% to 97% of paraphrased generations

claim: RAID 发现三类系统性失效：换采样策略、加 repetition penalty（准确率最多掉 32 个点）、换未见过的生成模型；结论是检测器尚不适合高风险部署。
source_title: RAID (ACL 2024)
quote: a repetition penalty decreases accuracy by up to 32 points regardless of decoding strategy ... are not yet robust enough for widespread deployment or high-stakes use

claim: 中文场景的「人机协作文本」更难检：C-HAT-Bench（5000 篇人类原文 + 24 万变体）显示，相对纯 AI 生成，协作生产模式下文档级检测器平均 AUROC 下降 12.0%，单模型最大降幅 44.4%。
source_title: C-HAT-Bench: Benchmarking Chinese AI-Text Detection Beyond Fully Generated Text
quote: mean AUROC across document-level detectors is 12.0% lower on the collaborative production modes, with the largest detector-specific relative decrease reaching 44.4%

claim: 普通人在 10 个文体的 500 篇文本上判别准确率约 59%（214 人、9164 条标注），且有把文本判为「人写」的倾向；同一实验中两个自动工具达 88%。
source_title: TURING: Evaluating Human Abilities to Identify AI-Generated Texts (LREC 2026)
quote: the humans accuracy was above chance but far from perfect (around 59%) ... two automated detection tools were tested, reaching 88% accuracy

claim: 254 名捷克母语者判别 55.4%（无反馈）vs 65.1%（即时反馈）——即「练一下」能提升，但不练只比瞎猜略好。
source_title: Learning to detect AI texts and learning the limits (PLOS One, 2025)
quote: The no feedback group showed considerably lower performance, with an average correctness rate of 55.4% ... while the feedback group achieved a higher average success rate of 65.1%

claim: 35 名专家（22 名医学专业 + 13 名人文学科文本分析专家）判 69 轮德国医学生论文 vs ChatGPT-3.5 生成文本：70% 判对，两组的判断主要依赖冗余、重复、线索连贯等文体特征，而非内容错误。
source_title: Detecting Artificial Intelligence–Generated Versus Human-Written Medical Student Essays (JMIR / PMC11914838)
quote: in 48 out of 69 (70%) decision rounds, participants accurately identified the AI-generated texts with minimal difference between groups ... While content errors had little impact on identification accuracy, stylistic features-particularly redundancy (OR 6.90, 95% CI 1.01-47.1), repetition (OR 8.05, 95% CI 1.25-51.7)
note: 原计划的德国讲师研究（57%/64%）ScienceDirect 机器人验证拦截，无法自行复核，改用可复核的 PMC 研究。

claim: 上限实验：19 名受过训练的专业标注者在 9 种语言、16 个数据集上平均准确率 87.6%，靠的是具体性、文化细节、长度/结构/情感的多样性差异，而非某个词。
source_title: Is Human-Like Text Liked by Humans? Multilingual Human Detection and Preference Against AI (ACL 2026)
quote: 19 annotators achieved an average detection accuracy of 87.6% ... major gaps between human and machine text lie in concreteness, cultural nuances, and diversity

claim: 高频用 LLM 写作的人（非专家训练）判 300 篇英文文章 TPR 92.7%、FPR 3.3%，5 人多数投票 300 篇只错 1 篇，超过几乎所有商用/开源检测器，只有 Pangram 的 Emi 模型能匹敌。
source_title: People who frequently use ChatGPT for writing tasks are accurate and robust detectors of AI-generated text (arXiv 2501.15654)
quote: achieving a TPR of 92.7% ... The average FPR for this population of annotators was 3.3% ... only the commercial Pangram model Emi and Spero (2024) matching their near-perfect detection accuracy
note: 预印本，作者与 Pangram 有对比但非其雇员。

claim: 「AI 味」词汇清单在 2026 年的新模型上已经失效：Graphite 在 1 万篇真人文章 + 9 万篇 9 个模型生成文章中发现 12,877 个「tell」，但 em dash 已不再被一致滥用——GPT-6 Astra 的使用量只有人类的 1/8，Claude Opus 5 与人类持平，Gemini 3.1 Pro 几乎不用。
source_title: AI Tells (Graphite research)
quote: The em dash is the best-known tell, but AI models no longer overuse it consistently. GPT-6 Astra uses em dashes about one-eighth as often as human writers, Claude Opus 5 uses them at about the human rate, and Gemini 3.1 Pro has nearly stopped using them.

claim: 把民间信号量化：em dash 每千词频率 AUROC 0.772（在 1% 误报预算下只能抓到 20.3% 的机器长文），「AI 词表」（delve/leverage/robust…）AUROC 只有 0.578；真正更稳的是词汇多样性 MATTR（0.791）与相邻句衔接（0.777）。
source_title: Burstiness, em dashes and "delve": the folk signals, measured (Opace Research)
quote: The em dash is real, and much weaker than its reputation ... 20.3% detection at a 1% false-positive budget ... The "AI words" list ... reaches AUROC 0.578

claim: 预设阈值的对照实验：10 条 tell 无一达到「机器使用率 10 倍 + AUC 0.90」的标准，最好的 tricolon 只有 AUC 0.80；同一模型换个目录（加载了禁止 em dash 的 CLAUDE.md）就从 6.10 个/千词变成 0.00。
source_title: No writing tell separates human from machine on its own: the best of 10 reaches AUC 0.80
quote: No rule cleared it. The best reached AUC 0.80, bootstrap interval 0.70 to 0.88 ... 6.10 against 0.00, is larger than any gap between 2 models in this study

claim: 词频层面的「人群级」信号是真实且可测的：15.1M 篇 PubMed 摘要中，2024 年至少 13.5% 经过 LLM 处理（部分子集达 40%），delve 出现率是历史预期的 28 倍，且新增的多是风格动词/形容词而非内容名词。
source_title: Delving into LLM-assisted writing in biomedical publications through excess vocabulary (Science Advances, 2025)
quote: at least 13.5% of 2024 abstracts were processed with LLMs ... delves (r = 28.0), underscores (r = 13.8), and showcasing (r = 10.7)

claim: 但这些词会「回流」到人类写作：ChatGPT 过用的词（delve、comprehend、boast、swift、meticulous）在播客与学术演讲里也出现上升，说明 tell 会随时间被人类吸收而失效。
source_title: How AI-generated prose diverges from human writing and why it matters (Reuters Institute)
quote: saw a spike in usage in conversational podcasts and academic YouTube talks after ChatGPT's release, suggesting that these words are now used more often by humans

claim: 中文检测的学术现状：编码器模型在分布外明显退化（RoBERTa 76.3%、BERT 79.3%），LoRA 微调的 Qwen2.5-7B 达 95.94%，说明「同分布高分、跨模型崩塌」同样成立。
source_title: LLM Encoder vs. Decoder: Robust Detection of Chinese AI-Generated Text with LoRA
quote: encoder models nearly memorize training data, they suffer significant performance degradation under distribution shifts (RoBERTa: 76.3% test accuracy; BERT: 79.3%) ... LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-7B achieves 95.94%

claim: 人民网「天目」系统宣称对国内外主要大模型生成的中文文本识别准确率 93%，其切入点是困惑度与词频（AI 倾向用高频词）。
source_title: 人民网「天目」智能识别系统发布
quote: 「天目」对国内外主要人工智能大模型生成中文文本的识别准确率达到93% ... 以语言模型的困惑度、词频特征为切入点
note: 厂商/机构自述，无独立复现。

claim: C2PA Content Credentials 是嵌入资产、用私钥签名的清单，验证器能确认「签名者是谁、字节是否被改」；规范明确它不判断内容真假。
source_title: C2PA and Content Credentials Explainer (spec 2.3)
quote: The C2PA Manifest is signed with the private key of the software or hardware that performed the operations ... It can confirm that the asset has not been modified since the C2PA Manifest was created

claim: C2PA 官网明确：凭证说明来源与历史，不用于断言内容「真实」；AI 工具若支持，会在凭证里标出「由 AI 生成」。
source_title: How it works (Content Authenticity Initiative)
quote: Content Credentials provide information about the origin and history of a piece of content, but they aren't intended to prescriptively indicate whether a piece of content is "real."

claim: 读者侧可直接使用的验证入口：Adobe Inspect（inspect.cr）与 verify.contentauthenticity.org，可看签名者、工具、动作与是否标注 AI 生成；缺失凭证不等于「不是 AI」。
source_title: How to check an image for C2PA Content Credentials
quote: Drop the file on Adobe's Inspect tool at inspect.cr ... If there is none, it says "No Content Credential."

claim: 凭证可被「排他区间」绕过：2026 年 10 月有人构造出签名有效但哈希排他区间覆盖整个文件的图片，没有任何验证工具报警——说明「有凭证」本身也不足以证明字节受保护。
source_title: How to check a Content Credential, and what it does not show (verifiable.pro)
quote: published an image with a single exclusion range that spanned the whole file. He said the image signature was valid but protected none of the file, and that no verification tool he could find flagged it.

claim: EU AI Act 第 50(2) 条自 2026-08-02 起要求生成式 AI 提供方把输出「以机器可读格式标记并使其可被检测为 AI 生成」，且标记与检测两者都要满足；2026-12-02 前已上市系统也须合规。
source_title: Guidelines on the implementation of the transparency obligations under Article 50 (C(2026) 5054)
quote: Each of the two above-mentioned elements must be fulfilled to achieve effectively the objectives ... Fulfilling only one element (e.g. for machine-readable marking of outputs without the means for their detection being available) will not suffice

claim: 第 50(4) 条对文本的要求比图像弱：只有「为告知公众公共利益的文本」需要披露，且经过人工编辑审校、有编辑责任人的可豁免。
source_title: Article 50: Transparency obligations (AI Act Service Desk)
quote: Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates text which is published with the purpose of informing the public on matters of public interest shall disclose that the text has been artificially generated or manipulated. This obligation shall not apply ... where the AI-generated content has undergone a process of human review or editorial control

claim: 欧委会联合研究中心把文本标记/检测的技术路线归为五类：水印、结构标记、元数据、日志、AI 文本检测，并逐一比较其对「有效性/鲁棒性/可靠性/可及性/互操作性」的满足度。
source_title: Technical solutions for marking and detecting AI generated text content in the context of Article 50(2)
quote: We categorize available techniques into five methodologies: watermarking, structural marking, metadata, logging and AI-generated text detection.

claim: 文本水印的真实部署状态（2026-10）：Google Gemini 默认带 SynthID-Text；Anthropic 自 2026-08/09 起在新模型上内置 SynthID-Text 系方案；OpenAI 的 textGrain 仅 EU 的 ChatGPT/Codex 且 API 默认关闭——三家都还没有面向公众的任意文本检测器。
source_title: Provenance signals in OpenAI-generated content (OpenAI Help Center)
quote: Text | textGrain watermarks (EU only) | In the EU, ChatGPT-generated text includes an invisible change to the randomness used in the model's word choices ... API customers globally can turn on text watermarks

claim: OpenAI 明确说 textGrain「不保证可靠检测」，且水印不验证准确性、不证明人类作者身份；其检测器只对经审核的研究者/机构开放，公开会因漏检与误报风险而不做。
source_title: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex (The Verge)
quote: it notes that textGrain "does not guarantee reliable detection," and says text watermarks don't verify accuracy, determine who owns the text, measure how much a human contributed, or prove human authorship.

claim: OpenAI 公布的 textGrain 检测曲线：1% 误报率下 200 token 约 80%、400 token 约 95% 可检出；把 25% 的词替换成同义词后检出率跌到 17%。
source_title: Who Watermarks What: AI Provider Tracker
quote: at a 1% false positive rate about 80% of 200-token and 95% of 400-token passages were detected; replacing 25% of words with synonyms cut detection to 17%

claim: Google 的 SynthID Detector 自 2026-10 起对所有人开放，但只接受图像/视频/音频文件，不接受文本——即「公开可查的水印」目前只覆盖多模态，不覆盖纯文本。
source_title: Provenance Week: OpenAI Watermarks ChatGPT Text in the EU, Google Opens SynthID Detector to Everyone
quote: Google's detector is open, but for media, not text, and only for SynthID partners.
